description: GDL 领域知识图谱 — 预填充常用 API 与 BIM 概念

api_functions.name: BLOCK
api_functions.description: 长方体，沿 X/Y/Z 方向延伸

api_functions.name: BRICK
api_functions.description: 与 BLOCK 等价的长方体命令

api_functions.name: CYLIND
api_functions.description: 圆柱体，高度 h，底面半径 r

api_functions.name: SPHERE
api_functions.description: 球体，半径 r

api_functions.name: CONE
api_functions.description: 圆锥/圆台，r1 底面半径，r2 顶面半径（0 为锥）

api_functions.name: PRISM_
api_functions.signature: n, h, x1, y1, s1, ..., xn, yn, sn
api_functions.description: 任意截面棱柱。n=顶点数，h=高度，后续每顶点三元组 (x, y, 边状态)

api_functions.name: ADD
api_functions.description: 平移变换入栈，必须配对 DEL

api_functions.name: ROT
api_functions.description: 旋转变换入栈（度数），必须配对 DEL

api_functions.name: MUL
api_functions.description: 缩放变换入栈，必须配对 DEL

api_functions.name: DEL
api_functions.description: 弹出最近 n 层变换栈，DEL 1 最常用

api_functions.name: DELALL
api_functions.description: 清空所有变换栈层

api_functions.name: MATERIAL
api_functions.description: 设置当前材质，参数为材质名称字符串或材质索引

api_functions.name: DEFINE MATERIAL
api_functions.description: 定义自定义材质，必须在 MATERIAL 引用前定义

api_functions.name: PEN
api_functions.description: 设置画笔颜色编号

api_functions.name: RECT
api_functions.description: 2D 矩形（由对角两点定义）

api_functions.name: LINE
api_functions.description: 2D 直线

api_functions.name: ARC
api_functions.description: 2D 圆弧，圆心(x,y)，半径 r，起止角度

api_functions.name: HOTSPOT
api_functions.description: 3D 热点，用于 Archicad 中拖拽操控

api_functions.name: HOTSPOT2
api_functions.description: 2D 热点

api_functions.name: PROJECT2
api_functions.description: 将 3D 几何投影到 2D 平面图

bim_concepts.name: Window
bim_concepts.init_pattern:
ADD 0, 0, 0
BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

bim_concepts.name: Door
bim_concepts.init_pattern:
ADD 0, 0, 0
BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

bim_concepts.name: Furniture
bim_concepts.init_pattern:
MATERIAL mat_name
ADD 0, 0, 0
BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

bim_concepts.name: Shelf
bim_concepts.description: 层架类构件，含多层搁板
bim_concepts.init_pattern:
FOR i = 1 TO shelf_count
  ADD 0, 0, (i-1) * shelf_spacing
  BLOCK A, B, shelf_thickness
  DEL 1
NEXT i

known_error_patterns.diagnosis: 变量名含 'mat_' 可能是材质变量未初始化。必须先调用 DEFINE MATERIAL 定义，再用 MATERIAL 引用。
known_error_patterns.fix_hint: 在使用前添加：DEFINE MATERIAL "变量名", r, g, b, ... 或改为引用已有材质名称字符串。
在使用前添加：DEFINE MATERIAL "变量名", r, g, b, ...
